title: Last chance
direction: American man, late twenties, textured mid-low voice with a light East Coast accent. Alone with your closest friend in a parked car. Begin quiet and honest, pause after 'Same rent', then let stubborn hope turn into resolve. Underplay it; no trailer narration.
text: I been parking rich men's cars since I was sixteen. Same corner. Same rent. Tonight, I pull up to that hotel, and somebody else takes my keys. Just keep the engine running. Let me have this one.
